programme.title: 驅魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亞連等人遭大衛和賈絲黛洛攻擊,他們因戴上「騙人眼鏡」被奪去正常的視覺。他們的視野充滿無數的鑰匙,大衛將從亞連身上搶來的鑰匙扔進那些幻影鑰匙堆中。之後亞連將尋找鑰匙的任務交付給拉比,轉身與柯洛利共同迎擊敵人。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #11
programme.desc: 為了探尋安妮莫奈魔力的根源,健一開始蒐集她母親的情報。但安妮莫奈並不感興趣,她的身體也發生變化…另一方面,馬洛來到健一的家中,他的目的是重建子爵家的財政並除掉索加拉姆。而健一也有一件必須告訴他的事情。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉絲。由於覲見國王需要時間,健一決定在王城一隅設置自己的房子。莉莉絲對健一召喚出的各種物品充滿興趣,並對他產生好感。兩人的距離感過於親近,被護衛視為不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法應戰!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #18
programme.desc: 妮可和久久換上巫女服,在伽羅的父親擔任宮司的神社幫忙。妮可在幫忙之餘,順便對用來製作紙垂的紙施展「動畫剪」的魔法,做出了會動的紙貓。而伽羅也立刻做了一隻鳥想讓它在天上飛,結果卻因為剪得不夠好而飛不起來……。然而,這張紙因為伽羅剪紙技術太糟導致形狀像是「式神」,並疑似因此創造出了不會消失的生命……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房間時發現了小時候妮可寫給他的信。信上寫著「給MOI:妮可永遠永遠都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他將這封信貼在牆上長達五年的時間,並且每天都受到這封信的鼓勵。因為今天是母親的忌日,守仁獨自一人前往掃墓。另一方面,妮可、監志、圭護、見晴及來乙木家玩的音夢從妮可口中聽到了她與和現在有些不同的小時候的守仁之間的往事。

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #3
programme.desc: 透過薇兒的策略,可瑪莉將約翰打得體無完膚。因此在部下之間掀起可瑪莉旋風,與他國的戰爭也是百戰百勝。但是在慶功宴出現了一名少女。她的名字是米莉桑德,過去與可瑪莉曾結下各種恩怨。米莉桑德突然襲擊,讓可瑪莉完全反應不過來……

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #4
programme.desc: 為了救出遭擄的薇兒,可瑪莉獨自去見米莉桑德。面對可瑪莉,米莉桑德開始講起三年前發生在學院的那起事件的真相。可瑪莉聽到米莉桑德充滿憎惡與殺意的話語,她下定決心戰鬥。三年前就讀同一間學院,卻踏上截然不同的道路的兩人,如今將再次交鋒!

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亞連等人遭大衛和賈絲黛洛攻擊,他們因戴上「騙人眼鏡」被奪去正常的視覺。他們的視野充滿無數的鑰匙,大衛將從亞連身上搶來的鑰匙扔進那些幻影鑰匙堆中。之後亞連將尋找鑰匙的任務交付給拉比,轉身與柯洛利共同迎擊敵人。

programme.title: 世界盡頭的聖騎士  #3
programme.desc: 15歲的威爾迎來與布拉德認真對打,一較高下的成人儀式。另一方面,古斯卻拜託他故意輸掉這場對決。威爾遲遲無法確認在廢墟都市時古斯釋放殺氣的真意,就這麼面臨了布拉德的考驗。

programme.title: 世界盡頭的聖騎士  #4
programme.desc: 突然現身的不死之神斯塔古內特試圖帶走布拉德與瑪利,古斯在千鈞一髮之際救下他們。眾人才剛放下心,就有一道黑霧劃開了古斯的胸口。斯塔古內特大膽地朝著呆立不動的威爾微笑,並道出一切都是多虧了他。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #11
programme.desc: 為了探尋安妮莫奈魔力的根源,健一開始蒐集她母親的情報。但安妮莫奈並不感興趣,她的身體也發生變化…另一方面,馬洛來到健一的家中,他的目的是重建子爵家的財政並除掉索加拉姆。而健一也有一件必須告訴他的事情。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉絲。由於覲見國王需要時間,健一決定在王城一隅設置自己的房子。莉莉絲對健一召喚出的各種物品充滿興趣,並對他產生好感。兩人的距離感過於親近,被護衛視為不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法應戰!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #18
programme.desc: 妮可和久久換上巫女服,在伽羅的父親擔任宮司的神社幫忙。妮可在幫忙之餘,順便對用來製作紙垂的紙施展「動畫剪」的魔法,做出了會動的紙貓。而伽羅也立刻做了一隻鳥想讓它在天上飛,結果卻因為剪得不夠好而飛不起來……。然而,這張紙因為伽羅剪紙技術太糟導致形狀像是「式神」,並疑似因此創造出了不會消失的生命……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房間時發現了小時候妮可寫給他的信。信上寫著「給MOI:妮可永遠永遠都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他將這封信貼在牆上長達五年的時間,並且每天都受到這封信的鼓勵。因為今天是母親的忌日,守仁獨自一人前往掃墓。另一方面,妮可、監志、圭護、見晴及來乙木家玩的音夢從妮可口中聽到了她與和現在有些不同的小時候的守仁之間的往事。

programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大衛和賈絲黛洛合體而成的賈絲大衛攻擊而身受重創。賈絲大衛擁有強大的力量,即使是亞連和拉比也無法與其抗衡。眾人對付這位棘手敵人時,房間開始崩塌。此時原本負傷倒下的柯洛利牽制住賈絲大衛,並催亞連等人盡快前進。

programme.desc: 健一一行人終於迎來與國王的會面,然而卻突然被命令與女魔導師梅麗莎進行御前比試,並要對抗她所召喚的下級龍。健一也召喚出挖土機,與安妮莫奈等人合力迎戰,但有下級龍強烈的龍息和堅硬的皮膚阻擋,他們的攻擊毫無作用!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #20
programme.desc: 圭護若沒有看見新月圖案就無法發揮強大的力量。妮可看見圭護臉上浮現出有些落寞的表情,於是交給他一枚注入了「飛天魔法」的戒指,並表示希望他能使用。只要能靈活使用應該就能成為一種武器……於是圭護懷抱著這個想法開始進行特訓。某天,音夢找正在進行秘密特訓的圭護講話。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #6
programme.desc: 伊織與耕平靠著作弊想辦法度過(?)了考試難關。雖然當初在聯誼上吃了不少苦頭,但今天是為「PaB」珍貴的新社員愛菜舉辦歡迎會的日子。愛菜原本期待能在新環境中展開青春的校園生活,然而她很快就察覺到這裡根本就沒有正常人。不過,大家在潛水方面態度倒是十分認真。在學會信號手勢等潛水基礎後,一行人開始以兩人一組結伴進行練習活動。另一方面,始終還沒解開千紗誤會的伊織卻被分到和她同一組……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #7
programme.desc: 伊織等人看著雜誌上介紹的宮古島特集,對能在美麗的大海中潛水感到非常嚮往。然而不知為何,在時田和壽的邀請下,他們即將進行網球雙打比賽!由於潛水時有兩人一組行動的結伴制度,因此與託付生命的夥伴建立信賴關係是非常重要的……而這些只是表面話,實際上是想從網球社團Tinker Bell手中奪取獎金,以報伊豆春季時的仇。PaB的成員們能在比賽中勝出嗎……!?

programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉絲。由於覲見國王需要時間,健一決定在王城一隅設置自己的房子。莉莉絲對健一召喚出的各種物品充滿興趣,並對他產生好感。兩人的距離感過於親近,被護衛視為不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法應戰!

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人終於迎來與國王的會面,然而卻突然被命令與女魔導師梅麗莎進行御前比試,並要對抗她所召喚的下級龍。健一也召喚出挖土機,與安妮莫奈等人合力迎戰,但有下級龍強烈的龍息和堅硬的皮膚阻擋,他們的攻擊毫無作用!

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #6
programme.desc: 伊織與耕平靠著作弊想辦法度過(?)了考試難關。雖然當初在聯誼上吃了不少苦頭,但今天是為「PaB」珍貴的新社員愛菜舉辦歡迎會的日子。愛菜原本期待能在新環境中展開青春的校園生活,然而她很快就察覺到這裡根本就沒有正常人。不過,大家在潛水方面態度倒是十分認真。在學會信號手勢等潛水基礎後,一行人開始以兩人一組結伴進行練習活動。另一方面,始終還沒解開千紗誤會的伊織卻被分到和她同一組……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #7
programme.desc: 伊織等人看著雜誌上介紹的宮古島特集,對能在美麗的大海中潛水感到非常嚮往。然而不知為何,在時田和壽的邀請下,他們即將進行網球雙打比賽!由於潛水時有兩人一組行動的結伴制度,因此與託付生命的夥伴建立信賴關係是非常重要的……而這些只是表面話,實際上是想從網球社團Tinker Bell手中奪取獎金,以報伊豆春季時的仇。PaB的成員們能在比賽中勝出嗎……!?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亞連等人遭大衛和賈絲黛洛攻擊,他們因戴上「騙人眼鏡」被奪去正常的視覺。他們的視野充滿無數的鑰匙,大衛將從亞連身上搶來的鑰匙扔進那些幻影鑰匙堆中。之後亞連將尋找鑰匙的任務交付給拉比,轉身與柯洛利共同迎擊敵人。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大衛和賈絲黛洛合體而成的賈絲大衛攻擊而身受重創。賈絲大衛擁有強大的力量,即使是亞連和拉比也無法與其抗衡。眾人對付這位棘手敵人時,房間開始崩塌。此時原本負傷倒下的柯洛利牽制住賈絲大衛,並催亞連等人盡快前進。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉絲。由於覲見國王需要時間,健一決定在王城一隅設置自己的房子。莉莉絲對健一召喚出的各種物品充滿興趣,並對他產生好感。兩人的距離感過於親近,被護衛視為不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法應戰!

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人終於迎來與國王的會面,然而卻突然被命令與女魔導師梅麗莎進行御前比試,並要對抗她所召喚的下級龍。健一也召喚出挖土機,與安妮莫奈等人合力迎戰,但有下級龍強烈的龍息和堅硬的皮膚阻擋,他們的攻擊毫無作用!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房間時發現了小時候妮可寫給他的信。信上寫著「給MOI:妮可永遠永遠都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他將這封信貼在牆上長達五年的時間,並且每天都受到這封信的鼓勵。因為今天是母親的忌日,守仁獨自一人前往掃墓。另一方面,妮可、監志、圭護、見晴及來乙木家玩的音夢從妮可口中聽到了她與和現在有些不同的小時候的守仁之間的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #20
programme.desc: 圭護若沒有看見新月圖案就無法發揮強大的力量。妮可看見圭護臉上浮現出有些落寞的表情,於是交給他一枚注入了「飛天魔法」的戒指,並表示希望他能使用。只要能靈活使用應該就能成為一種武器……於是圭護懷抱著這個想法開始進行特訓。某天,音夢找正在進行秘密特訓的圭護講話。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。

programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪們的委託下前往拜訪多惠。她察覺這尊一到夜晚就會隨機電死大量魚群的木偶身上寄宿著落於本地的「某異物」之力,具備與世間常理相悖的神祕力量。琴子等人立即著手計劃消滅木偶,然而它身上卻隱藏著一個祕密。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭賈絲大衛所創造的「鋼鐵處女」夾住後刺穿。他在逐漸模糊的意識中想起與亞連等人成為夥伴的回憶。房間正面臨倒塌的危機,賈絲大衛試圖逃離此處。就在此時,有一位意想不到的人物在虛幻之間出現在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的,於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例,女性將贈送手帕給男性,男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕,也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日,努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町預定參加日本偶像節,但必須決定誰將擔任中心位置,露比與MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因為她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町終於登上舞台。人群為MEM CYO歡呼, 露比以晚期的小愛般的魅力吸引粉絲,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #8
programme.desc: 沖繩集訓的相關費用必須各自靠打工賺。但伊織和耕平的日薪工收入卻都拿去喝酒花光了。而壽倒是很認真在打工,而且竟然還是當酒保。伊織和耕平對壽在店裡展現出與平時截然不同的氛圍感到困惑。之後在店長的好意下,兩人也決定嘗試體驗酒保的工作。然而,這兩個笨蛋對雞尾酒的做法當然是一竅不通,還接二連三地調出了許多危險的酒精炸彈……。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的,於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例,女性將贈送手帕給男性,男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕,也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日,努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努爾將被稱作山之主的魔物獻給了萊利娜後,讓兩人的距離從原本的契約關係逐漸開始有了變化,卻也讓萊利娜的命運籠罩在不祥的陰影之中。薇薇安對努爾抱有好感,卻連點燃神殿聖火的使命都被萊利娜奪走而懷恨在心,而此時,有一個人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町預定參加日本偶像節,但必須決定誰將擔任中心位置,露比與MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因為她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町終於登上舞台。人群為MEM CYO歡呼, 露比以晚期的小愛般的魅力吸引粉絲,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #7
programme.desc: 伊織等人看著雜誌上介紹的宮古島特集,對能在美麗的大海中潛水感到非常嚮往。然而不知為何,在時田和壽的邀請下,他們即將進行網球雙打比賽!由於潛水時有兩人一組行動的結伴制度,因此與託付生命的夥伴建立信賴關係是非常重要的……而這些只是表面話,實際上是想從網球社團Tinker Bell手中奪取獎金,以報伊豆春季時的仇。PaB的成員們能在比賽中勝出嗎……!?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大衛和賈絲黛洛合體而成的賈絲大衛攻擊而身受重創。賈絲大衛擁有強大的力量,即使是亞連和拉比也無法與其抗衡。眾人對付這位棘手敵人時,房間開始崩塌。此時原本負傷倒下的柯洛利牽制住賈絲大衛,並催亞連等人盡快前進。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭賈絲大衛所創造的「鋼鐵處女」夾住後刺穿。他在逐漸模糊的意識中想起與亞連等人成為夥伴的回憶。房間正面臨倒塌的危機,賈絲大衛試圖逃離此處。就在此時,有一位意想不到的人物在虛幻之間出現在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:愛是有『原』 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影專線:翻生奇兵
programme.desc: 文強自小被批為天煞孤星,誤打誤撞地來到方舟展館工作,遇上至潮上帝,少女慈禧、伊甸娃娃、羅馬兵丁、太空人、Indiana Jones等神蹟翻生;惡魔襲擊,文強如何靠著上帝和秘密武器應戰呢?

programme.title: 屬靈教室:孫雅各牧師-腓立比書
屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:愛是有『原』 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-十項全能的家系列
programme.desc: 羅馬書12:13 說:「聖徒缺乏,要幫補。」你覺得這也適用於你的家庭嗎?為什麼? 創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

鳳凰洲際快車 (101225)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰洲際快車》是鳳凰衛視子夜時段的新聞資訊節目,為您帶來兩岸三地,以及國際社會的大小新聞、最新動態和局勢發展。

programme.title: 有報天天讀 (91225)
programme.desc: 《有報天天讀》搜羅全球主流的媒體和重要報紙、雜誌的最新資訊和精華焦點,內容充實,資訊豐富,節奏明快,充滿動感和創意,是個既有個性,也有獨到見解的節目。

programme.title: 鳳凰大視野
programme.desc: 《鳳凰大視野》:鳳凰衛視力求創新,不為人後,推出鳳凰大視野一系列主題性紀錄片節目,每周連續播出某一專題,或是社會焦點、或是歷史紀念日、或特別行動、獨家內幕透析時代局勢,一氣呵成五集持續播出。

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 (1347)
programme.desc: 《紀錄大時代》:紀錄珍貴片段,重溫精彩大時代,《紀錄大時代》為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片,把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前。

programme.title: 亞洲財經透視 (1025)
programme.desc: 《亞洲財經透視》:立足於香港國際中心,關註每日資本市場動態,聚焦區內熱門政經事件。匯總境內外媒體多元財經觀點。

programme.title: 鳳凰衝擊播: 文化大觀園 (451)
programme.desc: 《文化大觀園》:節目關注中華文化中的大事件、大歷史、大人物和新發現,在紛繁的生活中給您清靜、雅致的空間,並通過我們的鏡頭去探尋中華文明中充滿迷幻、離奇的人物和故事。

programme.title: 鳳凰聚焦 (1027)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰聚焦》:關註重大時政選題,重大社會事件和新聞熱點。原創性挖掘更多事實與背景。分析梳理新聞的前期後果,人物命運,呈現權威觀點。

programme.title: 我們和牠們 (147)
programme.desc: 《我們和牠們》以紀實拍攝的手法,從人與動物、與自然和諧相處的角度,講述跨物種的感人故事,凸顯純潔善良的高尚情操。我們和牠們,人類與動物。同為地球之子,與自然和諧一體,萬物共生,以愛融通。鳳凰衛視中文台

programme.title: 鳳凰全球連線 (91225)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰全球連線》為你帶來世界各地的熱點新聞,並深入探討事件始末因由,分析事情的重要性。主持人會於直播時段,通過衛星、電話與全球各地的鳳凰衛視記者、特約記者、評論員連線,向你匯報當天要聞。

programme.title: 有報天天讀 (91225)
programme.desc: 《有報天天讀》搜羅全球主流的媒體和重要報紙、雜誌的最新資訊和精華焦點,內容充實,資訊豐富,節奏明快,充滿動感和創意,是個既有個性,也有獨到見解的節目。

programme.title: 香港熱廚房 (67)
programme.desc: 《香港熱廚房》是鳳凰衛視中文台《解碼香港》升級版,資深評論員程介南先生,邀請香港政經圈共聚熱廚房,取時事當食材,以此喻彼,見微知著,以創意為廚藝,化深厚為火候,庖丁解牛,分析解碼。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
茶煲世家#52粵
programme.desc: 家宜因牙痛失眠，而子東工作上諸多阻滯，二人同嘆運氣欠佳。耀國跟一風水佬賴大師研究風水，果能改善財運與工作運，令眾同事大表羨慕，子東不忿跟隨迷信。耀國將所學的風水學向同事們吹噓，並在公司擺吸水陣，此時Roger有一懂風水的客戶，告知Roger，耀國所擺的吸水陣影響Roger的橫財運，對方教Roger設陣破其吸水陣，結果被大老闆責罵，眾人終如夢初醒，不再相信風水。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘決定離京逃婚，趕到約定地點卻發現母親倒在血泊中，官府以其發現逃犯蹤跡被滅口結案，十一娘心生疑竇，到官府鳴冤要求重審案件，但卻被擋在門外，後來十一娘從慈安寺的清暝口中得知其母之死或與徐家有關…

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺購入帶子與元貝，端上「陳皮蒜蓉蒸元貝帶子」，讓阿譚親嚐兩種貝類海產在味道、口感的分別。坊間不少人蒸帶子前以粉絲鋪底，鼎爺指做法有好有壞，他又會否採用？鼎爺順道示範開、洗元貝與帶子的方法，並奉上鮮甜爽口的「西蘭花炒帶子」。此外，要有效清除西蘭花的殘留農藥，原來可靠白醋？紅蘿蔔與甘筍竟非同一食材？且聽鼎爺詳細講解。他還以米紙與春卷皮包裹餡料，炸出「雜菜鮮蝦卷」，帶來不同的酥脆口感。

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不同種類的靈芝與珍菌，在中醫學角度被認為具有補肺、防癌等功效。中醫博士帶來姬松茸、黃金菇、竹靈芝、西藏靈芝等，介紹相關保健資訊，並提供食用建議。粵劇富深厚歷史與藝術價值，為將這份文化繼續傳承，業界嘗試於箇中加入音樂劇等摩登元素，希望吸納年輕觀眾。名伶衛駿輝分享早前參演足球題材粵劇的經驗，也細談當年學藝點滴，還感嘆現今新一代的成長與學習環境相較幸福。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「芋蓉臘味扒紅燒豆腐」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 血管老化有損健康，大家卻未必清楚自己的血管年齡。鄧佩儀到廣州體驗銅砭刮痧後，背部刮痧顏色不一；中醫師淺談刮痧通血管原理，常拍打個別穴位，也有助血液循環？逆齡偵探以儀器檢測血管年齡，誰人未老先衰？心臟科醫生亦帶來讓血管年輕的貼士。眾人隨物理治療師做強化小腿肌肉運動，嘉賓王馨平再教進階瑜伽動作。有說壓力襪能令血管暢通，可有根據？戴祖儀、黃庭鋒前往宜蘭，要揭開冷泉養生秘密。另外，長敷急凍面膜竟有反效果！

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#11粵PG
programme.desc: 柏義表示搬住天龍舊居後，總是提不起精神。冠一甫見到天眼輝，便用錢打發他離開，正花證實心中所想，希望冠一說出真話。正花給予冠一解釋時限，表示時限一過便會與兆良展開新感情。月華身上有怪事發生，再加上林磊跟蹤柏義時所見，兩人認定天龍舊居有異，駿昇卻不太相信。曦昕晚上收到柏義來電，內有怪聲，駿昇決定親身到天龍舊居一看。家聰發短訊，催促冠一去阻正花與兆良發展，惟冠一正協助柏義行動，未能走開……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 亂太郎三人今天擔任打掃值日生，卻由於遊樂時間遭到縮短，完全提不起勁。山本梨子老師察覺他們態度欠缺認真，便換作年輕姿態加以訓斥，轉頭卻醒覺語氣太重，又換作老人姿態，嘗試打聽亂太郎他們偷懶的原因，可是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「廠長」蚌蚌公主為四名闖關女生設下三道考驗，大家表現如何？一名小兵於「廠長話」率先出局，餘下三人繼續比賽。廠長話要提速增加難度，怎料一個指令卻使三人同時犯錯被淘汰，要廠長給予機會「復活」再分勝負。果園採收任務中，小兵若觸響鈴鐺便需重新開始，會拖慢全程時間。但這回比拼，某隊雖然觸響鈴鐺次數較多，卻能以較快時間完成？兩位曲奇小兵都在第一輪「溶化之橋」成功運送五個雪糕球，但她們卻於第二輪減少運送數量……

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 為了拯救宙部界，阿渡嘗試請求阿驅一方讓出七彩方塊，阿翔與麥格堅決拒絕，雙方爆發一場七彩方塊爭奪戰。阿驅雖然察覺兩人有可疑，但知道對方真正關心自己，於是不惜召喚麒麟丸與阿渡大打出手。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 脊髓肌肉萎縮症患者，如果病情較輕，可以如何透過藥物和物理治療，改善日常生活？人需要營養來維持健康，新環節《營養補給站》，會教大家如何吸收營養。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有私人屋苑住戶投訴樓上鄰居亂拋煙頭，令其陽台草地與太陽傘屢遭點燃，造成破壞。事主曾向管理公司、警方求助，受滋擾情況卻未有改善，攝製隊前往了解。慈雲山伯伯拾後巷死魚、廚餘擺賣，引食安風波。有街坊驚悉母親購買的是黑心食物，找伯伯當面對質！街市內不少商戶亦曾多次勸阻伯伯卻不果，伯伯更稱拾取垃圾變賣只因環境所迫，並為了「愛心之舉」？這集揭露「黑心」背後。另外，零售業如何藉好客精神，為旅客提供愉快購物體驗？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2698粵
programme.desc: 樹仁乘搭小巴時拒絕佩戴安全帶，Jason等人「有樣學樣」，結果被警察票控。樹仁卻僥倖避過一劫，但仍不知悔改，還向眾人提到他沒扣安全帶卻能倖免於難的種種經歷，覺得自己是天選之人，認為根本無需扣安全帶。其後，樹仁因堅持不扣安全帶而被小巴司機拒載，但仍不肯屈服。樹根決意要讓樹仁吸取教訓，若水為此多番嘗試，卻吃盡苦頭。後來，樹仁與栢菲乘搭小巴，栢菲無法勸服他，遂陪他一同不扣安全帶，怎料小巴發生意外……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#20粵
programme.desc: 專業新聞獎頒獎典禮集結全行精英，不愛交際的家妍為尋找金主，也不得不作出改變。慧心忽被通傳，以安撫某人的情緒……SNK獲頒特別大獎，慧心上台奪走肇華手上獎項，頒予AI主播的真正幕後功臣蕊天和劉俊邦，贏盡全場掌聲。慧心再次榮獲最佳女主播獎，特邀方太上台分享。方太在謝辭中暗藏玄機，場內卻只有慧心讀懂……慧心突宣佈因不可抗力的理由，將有關雪君的報道全數下架，到底是新聞女王鋪路回歸SNK，抑或是另有打算？

programme.title: 去有風的地方#16粵普 及 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 之遙匆忙趕到民宿時，發現對方居然是紅豆，原來紅豆和林娜已經為接管民宿做好萬全準備，為此驚喜交加；羅泉通過小葫蘆得知有人在追曉春，心裡很忐忑；之遙忍不住要向許紅豆表白，紅豆故作矜持，提出有事情明天再說…

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 轉往馬拉喀什，浩棕獨遊夜市，感受當地夜生活。帶阿姐體驗藤籃刺繡文化，阿姐勾起童年回憶，揀藤籃款式時也為工作之用；浩棕的心心圖案為誰而刺？見識巴希亞宮的宏偉氣派後，兩主持坐馬車遊覽城市風光，再探索時裝設計大師的莊園，在仙人掌、竹林環抱下寫意一番！堅果油是當地名物，二人一試敲碎堅果、石磨種子步驟，品嚐麵包蘸堅果油、杏仁醬的風味。互贈心意，浩棕獻禮向阿姐的工作態度致敬，卻因阿姐的回禮影片而觸動泛淚……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#27粵PG
programme.desc: 卓凱派小絲及文雄跟蹤斯敏，輕易被悉破，斯敏要求與卓凱見面。啟發通知德信有人調查雪晴母親，德信承諾會對付那人。雪蘭受到德信手下以刀指嚇，情急下天堂出手救人，卻引起了德信的疑心。歡喜在少鋒幫助下得知大黑警真正身分。德信與King看準烏茲爾國出現貨幣危機，計劃洗黑錢圖利；另一方面，歡喜亦看準了是次發大財機會，準備參一腳。斯敏向卓凱細說對付德信原因，坦言無意對付嘉莉，並打算交出控制器，怎料被德信捷足先登。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有私人屋苑住戶投訴樓上鄰居亂拋煙頭，令其陽台草地與太陽傘屢遭點燃，造成破壞。事主曾向管理公司、警方求助，受滋擾情況卻未有改善，攝製隊前往了解。慈雲山伯伯拾後巷死魚、廚餘擺賣，引食安風波。有街坊驚悉母親購買的是黑心食物，找伯伯當面對質！街市內不少商戶亦曾多次勸阻伯伯卻不果，伯伯更稱拾取垃圾變賣只因環境所迫，並為了「愛心之舉」？這集揭露「黑心」背後。另外，零售業如何藉好客精神，為旅客提供愉快購物體驗？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不同種類的靈芝與珍菌，在中醫學角度被認為具有補肺、防癌等功效。中醫博士帶來姬松茸、黃金菇、竹靈芝、西藏靈芝等，介紹相關保健資訊，並提供食用建議。粵劇富深厚歷史與藝術價值，為將這份文化繼續傳承，業界嘗試於箇中加入音樂劇等摩登元素，希望吸納年輕觀眾。名伶衛駿輝分享早前參演足球題材粵劇的經驗，也細談當年學藝點滴，還感嘆現今新一代的成長與學習環境相較幸福。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「芋蓉臘味扒紅燒豆腐」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 血管老化有損健康，大家卻未必清楚自己的血管年齡。鄧佩儀到廣州體驗銅砭刮痧後，背部刮痧顏色不一；中醫師淺談刮痧通血管原理，常拍打個別穴位，也有助血液循環？逆齡偵探以儀器檢測血管年齡，誰人未老先衰？心臟科醫生亦帶來讓血管年輕的貼士。眾人隨物理治療師做強化小腿肌肉運動，嘉賓王馨平再教進階瑜伽動作。有說壓力襪能令血管暢通，可有根據？戴祖儀、黃庭鋒前往宜蘭，要揭開冷泉養生秘密。另外，長敷急凍面膜竟有反效果！

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#11粵PG
programme.desc: 柏義表示搬住天龍舊居後，總是提不起精神。冠一甫見到天眼輝，便用錢打發他離開，正花證實心中所想，希望冠一說出真話。正花給予冠一解釋時限，表示時限一過便會與兆良展開新感情。月華身上有怪事發生，再加上林磊跟蹤柏義時所見，兩人認定天龍舊居有異，駿昇卻不太相信。曦昕晚上收到柏義來電，內有怪聲，駿昇決定親身到天龍舊居一看。家聰發短訊，催促冠一去阻正花與兆良發展，惟冠一正協助柏義行動，未能走開……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#52粵
programme.desc: 家宜因牙痛失眠，而子東工作上諸多阻滯，二人同嘆運氣欠佳。耀國跟一風水佬賴大師研究風水，果能改善財運與工作運，令眾同事大表羨慕，子東不忿跟隨迷信。耀國將所學的風水學向同事們吹噓，並在公司擺吸水陣，此時Roger有一懂風水的客戶，告知Roger，耀國所擺的吸水陣影響Roger的橫財運，對方教Roger設陣破其吸水陣，結果被大老闆責罵，眾人終如夢初醒，不再相信風水。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘決定離京逃婚，趕到約定地點卻發現母親倒在血泊中，官府以其發現逃犯蹤跡被滅口結案，十一娘心生疑竇，到官府鳴冤要求重審案件，但卻被擋在門外，後來十一娘從慈安寺的清暝口中得知其母之死或與徐家有關…

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新台韓粵
programme.desc: 美食團在「舌戰」寶島壓軸一章，走遍台北市的大街、巷弄，細味「大件夾抵食」的海鮮蓋飯、調味考究的招牌烤肉、日式私房菜佳餚「牛五花燒肉」。主持人回到香港，輕嚼以時令海鮮巧製的壽司、天婦羅；繼而「豪歎」特色日式雞翼、烏冬、肉串及饅魚飯。「街坊尋味」環節，主持人嚐遍台、港兩地的小籠包出品，高下如何？「學廚PK賽」的比拼菜式為日本家庭料理「海草蒟蒻微辣炒」，小儀在「台灣篇」輸多贏少，這次能否贏尾彩？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
摩根大通特約:通悉牛熊粵
交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 脆肉鯇與草鯇雖屬相同品種，但因飼養方式不同，肉質、口感大有區別！鼎爺選購優質脆肉鯇，分別帶來「脆鯇炒蘭度」與「金針雲耳蒸脆鯇腩」。阿譚大讚炒出來的脆鯇片媲美斑球，有何烹調要訣？鼎爺還買來名貴的墨西哥遼參與寶石參，再以新鮮花蟹拆肉，及用老雞、金華火腿熬湯，巧製「雙參蟹肉羹」。他期間把滑豆腐切絲，精湛刀藝「無得輸」！阿譚以傳統中式甜品「焗西米布甸」孝敬拍檔。這款以蓮蓉作餡料的甜品，外香內軟，口感一流！

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 寒冷會刺激血管收縮，引致血壓上升，血液亦較易凝固，提高心臟病發的風險。心臟科醫生補充，冬季還有不少外來病菌，為心臟病患者增加健康風險，他們外遊時有甚麼要留意？著名畫家林天行為繪出香港夜景，花長時間探索，終透過水墨重彩將香港夜之美畫出，他會親自細說幾幅作品的特色。嘉賓亦憶述西藏之旅病重期間受啟發，創作西藏系列的深刻經歷。「睇餸食飯」，闊別多時的黃亞保示範「蟲草花爆炒海蜇」，爽脆鮮甜兼有鑊氣。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 三十過後骨骼出現負增長，要保持骨骼健康有何妙法？戴祖儀為舒緩腰痛甘願雙腿受綁，效果令人意想不到，脊醫講解箇中道理，脊椎過直或過彎的舒緩方法大不同？細說倒立機如何達致放鬆腰部的功用。鄺潔楹、張秀文嘗試日本火熱的零位訓練，潔楹更在短短數分鐘增高3cm！原來只是錯覺？物理治療師拆解當中秘密，另告誡切勿亂用頸部牽引器舒緩頸痛。逆齡偵探到廣州體驗挪威引入的矯正療程，黃庭鋒、鄧佩儀慘被吊起，所為何事？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一與柏義合謀，成功從駿昇口中得知天龍失蹤原因。冠一趕往酒店，得悉正花已有抉擇，只好死心。正花與兆良談起未來的理想生活，突然提出閃婚。麗芬主動親近冠一，又告知正花決定閃婚。柏義與曦昕同困升降機內，曦昕承認惦念他，但不能原諒他太多瞞騙，難以復合。柏義認為正花閃婚，只是想冠一坦白真相，冠一有所決定……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 潮江前輩與立花前輩一同實習，並在開始前擬定好計劃，立花在關口刻意被捕，再由假扮士兵的潮江救出。當立花即將成功之際，卻被新丁與喜三太發現，二人還以為立花大禍臨頭，欲協助他化險為夷……

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 蜂場負責人攜同養蜂箱作客「Kids’ Notes」，力求豐富大家對養蜂的相關知識。過往養蜂之法與現今有何不同？蜂箱內的蜜蜂分工明確，蜂后、工蜂各司其職，最高峰時期可容納三千隻蜜蜂，但當「蝸居」內的蜜蜂數量減少，為何卻要壓縮牠們的居住空間？原來與蜜蜂的健康有關。嘉賓還展示一些養蜂工具，也帶來沖蜜糖水的建議。據說蜜糖可長久保存不易變質，嘉賓提醒要視乎存放的環境，而香港天氣潮濕，宜放進雪櫃保存。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿驅加入阿渡的隊伍，一行人去到舉行儀式的地方，按照瑪蘿手上的食譜把七彩方塊烹調後，方塊竟然懂得開口說話，此時阿翔和麥格來襲，苦戰期間，龍神用問答方式幫助阿渡探索內心真正的願望。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 荃灣有樓齡近30年屋苑，單位大裝修後才發現樓上漏水，影響到浴室天花，窗戶防水膠也老化，怎樣解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2699粵
programme.desc: Elaine為某商品設計宣傳海報，壯縱察覺不妥卻不忍批評。Elaine一時疏忽，將未通過的海報發佈至其社交平台，惹來網民劣評。璟風急向客戶補救，並於Elaine懇求下允許她修改海報。Elaine請Joe為新海報給予意見，Joe直接批評，並建議她再詢問壯的看法，她卻察覺壯不肯說老實話。另一方面，壯見Elaine近來與Joe親近，心生憂慮，其後得知真相，遂想挽回Elaine的信任，卻「撞大板」……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#21粵
programme.desc: 家妍深信雪君仍藏身香港，但詩晴為保全自身利益，決定抽身，二人不歡而散。肇華藉方太的負面傳聞發動突襲，企圖顛覆SNK權力格局。心碎的家妍拍片交代NovusVera事件，更做出令不少人震驚的抉擇。另邊廂，雪君給予慧心的資料，內藏驚人秘密，還觸及一場國際關係風波……方太為阻肇華吞併SNK，提出與慧心上契，將權力及股份轉讓，卻未能如願……肇華接連出招，對SNK來勢洶洶，慧心不再猶豫，決意要展開反擊……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#17粵普 及 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 明宇看中老宅作為書屋選址，紅豆的民宿也啟動工程，之遙幫忙安排師傅裝修。網店銷量大增，大家都忙不過來，村子又因網紅宣傳而遊客激增。之遙等人商量應對方法，決定動員村民幫忙，只有林娜心事重重，想請假卻被拒。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 阿姐的最佳旅伴登場，丈夫羅家英與她同遊不丹。首都廷布第一站前往「不丹彌敦道」觀光，阿姐瞥見有幸運彩票出售，即着家英哥「科金」購買。家英哥笑稱二人流落街頭坐在路旁，阿姐鬼馬提議他即興唱出乞討題材粵曲。繼續牽手逛街，他們找到一家香港市場，店裡可有香港特色？家英哥做足功課，帶阿姐到釋迦牟尼寺廟參觀並介紹相關資料，其後竟稱對牛彈琴？搜羅手信，家英哥提出為阿姐「埋單」卻被拒，更醒起零用錢都已交到對方手上……

programme.desc: 卓凱發現斯敏失蹤，遍尋不獲。德信想留住嘉莉在自己身邊而欺騙她，並向她求婚，嘉莉猶豫。卓凱與道行無意中發現啟發年輕時的相片，找到重要線索。歡喜叮囑少鋒好好準備翌日對付德信的行動，少鋒有感自己有機會於復仇行動之中喪命，於是現身淑梅面前，帶她到主題公園遊玩，留下最美回憶後，少鋒黯然離去，淑梅不能阻止而憂心忡忡。歡喜計劃的暗殺行動失敗，少鋒還被長興眾人捉走毒打，德信要求天堂槍殺少鋒……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 寒冷會刺激血管收縮，引致血壓上升，血液亦較易凝固，提高心臟病發的風險。心臟科醫生補充，冬季還有不少外來病菌，為心臟病患者增加健康風險，他們外遊時有甚麼要留意？著名畫家林天行為繪出香港夜景，花長時間探索，終透過水墨重彩將香港夜之美畫出，他會親自細說幾幅作品的特色。嘉賓亦憶述西藏之旅病重期間受啟發，創作西藏系列的深刻經歷。「睇餸食飯」，闊別多時的黃亞保示範「蟲草花爆炒海蜇」，爽脆鮮甜兼有鑊氣。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 三十過後骨骼出現負增長，要保持骨骼健康有何妙法？戴祖儀為舒緩腰痛甘願雙腿受綁，效果令人意想不到，脊醫講解箇中道理，脊椎過直或過彎的舒緩方法大不同？細說倒立機如何達致放鬆腰部的功用。鄺潔楹、張秀文嘗試日本火熱的零位訓練，潔楹更在短短數分鐘增高3cm！原來只是錯覺？物理治療師拆解當中秘密，另告誡切勿亂用頸部牽引器舒緩頸痛。逆齡偵探到廣州體驗挪威引入的矯正療程，黃庭鋒、鄧佩儀慘被吊起，所為何事？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一與柏義合謀，成功從駿昇口中得知天龍失蹤原因。冠一趕往酒店，得悉正花已有抉擇，只好死心。正花與兆良談起未來的理想生活，突然提出閃婚。麗芬主動親近冠一，又告知正花決定閃婚。柏義與曦昕同困升降機內，曦昕承認惦念他，但不能原諒他太多瞞騙，難以復合。柏義認為正花閃婚，只是想冠一坦白真相，冠一有所決定……

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 脆肉鯇與草鯇雖屬相同品種，但因飼養方式不同，肉質、口感大有區別！鼎爺選購優質脆肉鯇，分別帶來「脆鯇炒蘭度」與「金針雲耳蒸脆鯇腩」。阿譚大讚炒出來的脆鯇片媲美斑球，有何烹調要訣？鼎爺還買來名貴的墨西哥遼參與寶石參，再以新鮮花蟹拆肉，及用老雞、金華火腿熬湯，巧製「雙參蟹肉羹」。他期間把滑豆腐切絲，精湛刀藝「無得輸」！阿譚以傳統中式甜品「焗西米布甸」孝敬拍檔。這款以蓮蓉作餡料的甜品，外香內軟，口感一流！

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 「大美人」李嘉欣被Jade的美食引誘而來，品嚐Jade悉心準備的「凱撒沙律」、「龍蝦意大利飯」、「藍莓士多啤梨蛋白酥」。嘉欣回憶參選港姐的點滴，談談事業與家庭，原來美人也有不為人知的出糗尷尬時！

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 跟薛家燕邊食邊傾，談起黯然銷魂飯，她立即扮失憶！家燕姐如此聰明，為何頭飾仍是那麼多？六號多次舉報成功，謝東閔單刀直入令人中招，值得一讚！蔡潔玩過後，才知眾人原來這麼奸險！「狼人」對陣，刺客出手第一晚，明明太醫救了皇帝，皇帝及後竟被劊子手陳煒所殺！遊戲經五晚才結束，最終是好人，還是壞人勝出？「真假話題」，家燕姐自稱曾遭串謀綁架，當時更驚到喊！姜皓文憶述年少時與母親聯手捉拿入屋的小偷，故事可有破綻？

programme.desc: 煎魚最怕黏鑊，容易燒焦之餘，賣相亦大打折扣！要減少魚腥味，又有甚麼要點？鼎爺傳授「豉汁煎封鯧魚」的竅門，還會講解鷹鯧與白鯧的分別。簡單的家常小炒，亦講求不少下廚技巧。鼎爺奉上香嫩可口的「雞絲炒粉絲」，炒合前更特意把粉絲放進雞湯浸軟，粉絲味道得以大大提升！鼎爺及後以巧手將原隻雞去骨並加入豐富配料，再把雞放入豬肚內，燉煮成一道功夫菜「悟能懷鳳胎」。阿譚急不及待品嚐鼎爺「手勢」，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 滙豐呈獻：英雄召集：點解電競係電競粵
programme.desc: 電競運動熱潮席捲全球！戴祖儀、曾展望、葉蒨文、林俊其、吳俊峰、曾文心、吳文懿等「電競星團」成員，聯同電競界知名評述「老星」主持的前奏節目《英雄召集：點解電競係電競》，會輕鬆有趣地分享相關知識與資訊，讓觀眾做好準備，迎接即將陸續上演的精彩電競賽事！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 免疫及過敏病科醫生指食物過敏主要受後天因素影響，更提到有研究發現如能盡早讓嬰兒接觸不同食物，引發過敏機會就較低。醫生述說八大致敏食物，又提醒小麥易被忽略，為甚麼？除了診治資訊，醫生還帶來應對過敏的保護策略。為推動傷健共融，著名舞蹈家成立團體「舞蹈天使」，讓不同殘障人士亦可感受舞蹈的魅力。創辦人到臨，分享學員習舞後的轉變，更難忘一次與學員在雨中共舞的演出。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅示範「咖哩燴牛脷」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 手機不離身的吳業坤近日「眼矇」兼「耳聾」，疑患耳目失靈症。眼科醫生細說手機所釋藍光對眼睛的影響；許文軒竟被驗出患上乾眼症！坤哥試戴日本大熱的視力眼罩來個小測試，神奇地一秒變「光明」？副社長麥美恩指導偵探們與坤哥做鬼臉式眼部瑜伽，皮膚科醫生還帶來雙眼保持緊緻的貼士。黃庭鋒到廣州親試採耳，並認識像音叉般的獨特工具。眾人又體驗悠久的「鳴天鼓」養生法，感覺如何？此外，中醫師另會教授可預防口臭的牙齦按摩法。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一想離開傷心地，向駿昇提出辭職。柏義被調往管理酒店，駿昇指此舉是保護曦昕，月華則認為他有可能破壞一對真心相愛的戀人。冠一收駿昇來電，邀他參與賭王與牌王對決，冠一最終助駿昇大勝。駿昇以高薪挽留他，冠一仍堅持離開。柏義決定向曦昕解釋清楚，修補兩人關係，卻遭冠一急電叫停，直指駿昇之前所說的全是謊言。柏義帶曦昕離家出走時，遇意外連人帶車墮海……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 五年級生與六年級生的比試進入白熱階段，扮演被抓那方的小丸與新丁已相繼被擒，至於亂太郎則趁著混亂闖進後後山，希望能避開一眾來勢洶洶的前輩。這場後輩與前輩之戰，勝利將會花落誰家？

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 今天是樂園學園的家長觀課日，陽葵的父母與妹妹陽彩全家到齊，還很早就來到校內參觀。就在這時，陽彩與趕上學的小學生遊真碰過正著，事後發現自己丟失了與美月同款的唇膏，令她整天都在愁眉苦臉。

programme.desc: 潮偉與某特務秘密聯絡，對方要求潮偉重出江湖，以對付一名危害特務組織的危險人物。已有多名特務因該人而非死即傷，為拯救眾人，潮偉無奈答應執行任務。另一邊廂，尚善發現不少蛛絲馬跡，懷疑潮偉有事隱瞞，更擔心他將不辭而別，暗中執行危險任務，遂決意設法挽留。城安知悉後，聯同熊家眾人出謀獻策，惟尚善否決眾人提議，打算自行解決此事，為此付出不少努力……潮偉藉詞出埠展開行動，尚善、城安暗中尾隨，怎料突生變故……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#22粵PG
programme.desc: 劉艷意外介入一宗虐兒案，由於錄影模糊，調查困難重重。另一邊廂，慧心積極拉攏SNK董事，與肇華的權力角力越加激烈。家妍忍不住出手，助劉艷調查虐兒案報道。劉艷揭露出社區保母的外判漏洞，惟因追訪時摔傷，意外被揭破隱瞞多時的秘密……慧心正面報道新式治療癌症儀器，芷瑤趁機在網台抹黑慧心與儀器持有人書昀，要妖魔化儀器。病人的命運，正隨着輿論風向而變幻莫測……

programme.desc: 卓凱指少鋒遇險後無法聯絡天堂，淑梅往找天堂了解背後真相，卻見他喝得爛醉如泥。天堂向卓凱坦白事件，卓凱認定他沒有做錯。歡喜約見卓凱，交出雪晴的手機，希望助他揪出黑警勢力。德信與King商量洗黑錢事宜，天堂方知德信還有第二批錢，而歡喜亦找到合夥人洗黑錢。卓凱希望嘉莉幫忙尋找斯敏，嘉莉推敲出是德信所為，答應試探德信。歡喜拜祭亡妻，卓凱指已得知歡喜身份秘密，勸他收手，歡喜不以為然，聲言一定會竭盡全力復仇。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 免疫及過敏病科醫生指食物過敏主要受後天因素影響，更提到有研究發現如能盡早讓嬰兒接觸不同食物，引發過敏機會就較低。醫生述說八大致敏食物，又提醒小麥易被忽略，為甚麼？除了診治資訊，醫生還帶來應對過敏的保護策略。為推動傷健共融，著名舞蹈家成立團體「舞蹈天使」，讓不同殘障人士亦可感受舞蹈的魅力。創辦人到臨，分享學員習舞後的轉變，更難忘一次與學員在雨中共舞的演出。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅示範「咖哩燴牛脷」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 手機不離身的吳業坤近日「眼矇」兼「耳聾」，疑患耳目失靈症。眼科醫生細說手機所釋藍光對眼睛的影響；許文軒竟被驗出患上乾眼症！坤哥試戴日本大熱的視力眼罩來個小測試，神奇地一秒變「光明」？副社長麥美恩指導偵探們與坤哥做鬼臉式眼部瑜伽，皮膚科醫生還帶來雙眼保持緊緻的貼士。黃庭鋒到廣州親試採耳，並認識像音叉般的獨特工具。眾人又體驗悠久的「鳴天鼓」養生法，感覺如何？此外，中醫師另會教授可預防口臭的牙齦按摩法。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一想離開傷心地，向駿昇提出辭職。柏義被調往管理酒店，駿昇指此舉是保護曦昕，月華則認為他有可能破壞一對真心相愛的戀人。冠一收駿昇來電，邀他參與賭王與牌王對決，冠一最終助駿昇大勝。駿昇以高薪挽留他，冠一仍堅持離開。柏義決定向曦昕解釋清楚，修補兩人關係，卻遭冠一急電叫停，直指駿昇之前所說的全是謊言。柏義帶曦昕離家出走時，遇意外連人帶車墮海……

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 煎魚最怕黏鑊，容易燒焦之餘，賣相亦大打折扣！要減少魚腥味，又有甚麼要點？鼎爺傳授「豉汁煎封鯧魚」的竅門，還會講解鷹鯧與白鯧的分別。簡單的家常小炒，亦講求不少下廚技巧。鼎爺奉上香嫩可口的「雞絲炒粉絲」，炒合前更特意把粉絲放進雞湯浸軟，粉絲味道得以大大提升！鼎爺及後以巧手將原隻雞去骨並加入豐富配料，再把雞放入豬肚內，燉煮成一道功夫菜「悟能懷鳳胎」。阿譚急不及待品嚐鼎爺「手勢」，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 閨密教煮粵
programme.desc: 鄭秀文為閨密跳入「食海」，拋開修身大計享用Jade精心炮製的「三文魚他他」、「紅酒汁慢煮牛扒」、「雲呢拿雪糕配車厘子汁」；席間細訴入行近三十年來的點滴，分享情緒病帶給她的人生體會。

programme.title: 關你家事粵
programme.desc: 54歲的Frankie原本從事建材生意，可惜後來與岳父因財失和，被對方伺機吞併生意，更因財困而與妻子交惡，面臨離婚關口。鬥志盡失的Frankie親臨節目，分享連串風波的來龍去脈。心理學家林玥彤、家庭治療師程翠雲提供心靈指導，助Frankie重整旗豉，修補夫妻溝通橋樑。主持看不過眼Frankie的頹喪形象，決定邀請造型師替他改頭換面，效果令人驚喜！藝人嘉賓單立文若與太太出現爭執，又會如何「拆彈」？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 「鰽白魚骨裝飾製作技藝」、「木雕刻技藝」和「墓碑雕刻技藝」同名列於本港首份非物質文化遺產清單。民間工藝家馮啟仁，憑祖父的口頭傳述，摸索到如何把「魚骨變鳳凰」，他親身示範如何收集適合的魚骨作材料，逐一講解各個部件的形態，並示範如何砌成栩栩如生的雀鳥。神佛像工藝師王燮祥如何把一塊木頭製成一尊佛像？他的三位兒子對這份工作的前景有何看法？打石師傅蕭海波八十年代加入打石行列，他何以會選擇墓碑雕刻這門工作？

programme.title: 往哪跑！(完)
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 彼得與狼奇遇記
programme.desc: 擅長解決問題的小學生彼得，在路上救了一隻狼後，意外展開穿越時空的奇幻冒險！勇者與惡龍、精靈與半人馬、複製人與隱形人……彼得與狼的精采奇遇，就此展開！

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林(完)
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, Three Sinners is a Huangmei Opera about love, betrayal, murder, and redemption. Starring Hong Kong's premiere movie couple, it is one of the grandest Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musicals in the Shaw Brothers library.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: Ah Kam, a seasoned prostitute, gets locked inside an ATM vestibule with a thief. Both discover they are ill-fated in life and Ah Kam starts telling him her life story as a prostitute, from a teenage hooker to a PR girl in an upscale club in her thirties, as well as being a strip dancer, bar girl and masseuse.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Mun undergoes a cornea transplant to correct her blindness, but ends up gaining more than the gift of sight. She shockingly realises that she is seeing another woman instead of herself whenever she looks into a mirror. Recalling that things changed ever since her cornea was replaced, Mun vows to uncover the truth behind her strange vision...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: The Vibe
programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The content focuses on exciting new trends, fashion, and cultural topics across a range of disciplines both in China and abroad. programme.title: Asia Today
programme.desc: Asia Today highlights the latest news and social developments across Asia. Correspondents in over a dozen countries report on the region’s top stories as they happen. Analysts bring Asian perspective to topical and developing issues. Asia Today also emphasizes the diverse cultures and lifestyles of the world’s most populous continent.

programme.title: Dialogue
programme.desc: Dialogue is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN. Inviting decision makers in government, business and academia onto the show, the host encourages guests to speak their minds frankly.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Decoy
programme.desc: Tom’s leadership abilities come into question by Eugene when his decisions lead to failure while attempting to confront Buzzsaw.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunder’s home realm.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Troublesome Treachery of the Thieving Toot Fairy
programme.desc: George and Harold race against Mr. Krupp to try to get him fired before they get expelled

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. KruppCaptain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queen's underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragon's Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragon's Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Razor's Edge
programme.desc: Keith and Krolia cross a new space universe in search of a powerful source of Quintessence

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Punch Thunk Love Nay Boors
programme.desc: When Eep and the others try to intervene with Thunk and Blurg's first date, they decide to run away so they can live happily ever after; Snoot and Ugga race each other to get to the Doomsday Skunkguin but are forced to put their differences aside once the weirder animals come out to hunt them down

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Warm Welcome
programme.desc: While Lucky and Spirit continue to explore a life in the circus, best friends Pru and Abigail set out to lasso in their friend back home. With new frontiers, new sights, and new friends the PALs ride free like never-before on wild circus adventures only to realize that there's no place like home.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Ton-Ton And Scrap-It
programme.desc: After fighting gets them stuck in a dangerous situation, enemies Skrap-It and Ton-Ton must join forces to save themselves.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Crocky's Coconut
programme.desc: Crocky has entrusted Raa Raa with his very special coconut to look after. Raa Raa does his very best to keep it safe. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Kings and Queens Of The Jungle
programme.desc: Topsy takes a game of Kings and Queens too seriously and starts to boss the other animals around. The animals don't want to play with her anymore, can Topsy help them change their mind?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa Goes Hunting
programme.desc: Raa Raa has lost his toothbrush and sets off to find it. Where can it be?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - The Noisiest House In The Jungle
programme.desc: The animals are exploring what noises each of their houses make… whose house do we think is the noisiest in the whole of the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Boomy Thunder
programme.desc: Theres a storm in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but noone is sure what the loud thumps coming from the sky are. Raa Raa sets off to find out.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Rainy Stick
programme.desc: Raa Raa is intrigued when he hears a whooshy rainy noise but its not raining. Following the sound he discovers Ooo Ooo with a rainy stick his favourite thing

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Defenders
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Horrible Hostilities of the Homework Hydra
programme.desc: When George and Harold go back in time to stop the invention of homework, they realize they also eliminated the most important thing in the world: comic books

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Theo 100
programme.desc: With the Baby Corp babies exiled from their office and hiding in the Templeton basement, Boss and a trusted team storm Baby Corp to take it back from the villains. Having decided to retire and pass the CEO-ship onto to Staci, he also prepares Tim for her new life as an older brother to just a normal baby brother.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Growing Paints
programme.desc: When Grug thinks his forehead looks too big in Ugga's family portrait, she strives to make the painting disappear.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Magma Breather
programme.desc: Tom has to keep his mom, Olivia, distracted while Jun, Alex, and D’Angelo use a new dragon to close off a cave leading to the Crystal Realm, and prevent her from discovering the dragons.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Toad-al Recall
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items - but Jin and Peng aren’t so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Apple of My IreFunsgiving
programme.desc: After all their adventures, Branch no longer finds Cloud Guy as annoying as he once did. But to Cloud Guy, this is an unacceptable betrayal of their adversarial relationship. Dejected, he sets out to find a new rival to annoy.Biggie is hosting Funsgiving this year, and is therefore charged with preparing all of the best dishes for his friends. But in his quest to make things perfect, he goes a little too far…

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train.
